An '''individual''' was hired by the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] to coordinate [[Gender/Legends|his]] largest shipment of [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At [[Mos Espa Circuit]], Watto contacted the individual through a [[Hologlide J57 cam droid/Legends|cam droid]], asking for the pit [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to be led from their [[Unidentified freighter (Tatooine)|freighter]], which landed in Mos Espa, to the city's [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] circuit. The contractor eventually succeeded in delivering the pit droids to the circuit with the assistance of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Pit Droids">''[[Star Wars: Pit Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The player in the ''[[Star Wars: Pit Droids]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] plays as the contractor for Watto.<ref name="Pit Droids" />
